name: Resilience
about: Resilience (2025-010B, ISPACE), launched 2025 Jan 15. Its phases from GCAT: Earth, Luna, 4.53W 60.49N. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
